command.openWebUI: Open the dsh Web UI in Browser
config.runtime.path: Path to the dsh executable. When empty, `dsh` is looked up on `PATH` (the command installed by DeepSeek Desktop, or `npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh`).
config.runtime.profile: dsh profile to start. Defaults to `web`, which shares models, API keys and permission presets with your own `dsh web`.
config.zcode.path: Path to the ZCode executable or desktop-bundled `zcode.cjs`. When empty, `zcode` is looked up on `PATH` or inside the official ZCode Desktop installation.
config.claude.path: Path to the Claude Code (`claude`) executable. When empty, `claude` is looked up on `PATH` or `~/.local/bin` / `~/.claude`, running natively via `claude -p` stream-json mode.
config.pi.path: Path to the Pi Coding Agent (`pi`) executable. When empty, `pi` is looked up on `PATH` or `~/.pi/bin`, running natively via `pi --mode rpc`.
config.codex.path: Path to the OpenAI Codex (`codex`) executable. When empty, `codex` is looked up on `PATH` or `~/.codex/bin`, running natively via `codex app-server`.
config.codebuddy.path: Path to the Tencent CodeBuddy (`codebuddy` / `cbc`) executable. When empty, `codebuddy` is looked up on `PATH` or `~/.codebuddy/bin`, running natively via `codebuddy -p` stream-json mode.
config.context.includeActiveEditor: Attach the active editor to messages by default: the selected code with line numbers when there is a selection, otherwise just the file path (dsh reads the file when it needs to). Each message can opt out with the chip above the input box.
config.ui.language.auto: Follow the VS Code display language (Chinese for Chinese, English otherwise)
config.ui.fontSize: Reading & chat font size (px), shared by chat replies, plans, and Markdown file previews. `0` follows VS Code (workbench font size plus 1px).
config.ui.fontFamily: Reading & chat font family, shared by chat replies, plans, and Markdown file previews. Empty follows the VS Code workbench font.
config.ui.lineHeight: Reading & chat line height, shared by chat replies, plans, and Markdown file previews. `0` uses the default `1.6`.
config.ui.paragraphSpacing: Reading & chat paragraph spacing (px), shared by chat replies, plans, and Markdown file previews. `-1` uses the default `10`.
config.ui.contentWidth: Maximum content width (px) for chat replies, plans, and Markdown previews. `0` uses the default `820`.
config.ui.codeFontFamily: Monospace font family for terminal output, file paths, and code blocks. Empty follows `editor.fontFamily`.
config.ui.terminalFontSize: Font size (px) for terminal and command output. `0` uses the default `12`.
config.ui.terminalLineHeight: Line height for terminal and command output. `0` uses the default `1.6`.
config.ui.showTurnChanges: Show a changed-files card at the end of each reply. Off by default: the bar above the input box already lists the files changed in this session.
config.title: Halo
container.title: Halo
extension.description: A VS Code chat panel for coding agents: native DeepSeek (dsh), Claude Code (claude -p), Codex (codex app-server), CodeBuddy (codebuddy -p), Pi (pi --mode rpc) and ZCode, plus ACP agents such as Antigravity and OpenCode
capabilities.untrusted: The agent reads and writes files and runs commands in the workspace, so the workspace must be trusted.
config.defaultBackend: Default agent ID started on launch (for example `dsh`, `claude`, `codex`, `codebuddy`, `pi`, `zcode`, `antigravity`, `opencode`, or a custom ACP agent ID). Selecting an agent in Settings updates this automatically.
config.backends: Extra agents reachable over ACP (Agent Client Protocol). DeepSeek (dsh), Claude Code (`claude -p`), Codex (`codex app-server`), CodeBuddy (`codebuddy -p`), Pi (`pi --mode rpc`), ZCode (`zcode app-server --stdio`), OpenCode (`opencode acp`) and Antigravity (`agy acp`) are built in; an entry with the `id` of a built-in ACP one (`opencode`, `antigravity`) replaces it, for example to give the full path of the command. Each entry needs a `name` and the `command` (plus `args`) that starts the agent in ACP mode. Switch from the chat panel's Settings page or the "Switch Agent" command.
config.backends.id: Stable id (defaults to the name). Sessions and tabs are remembered per id.
config.backends.name: Name shown in the panel, e.g. `oh-my-pi`.
config.backends.command: Executable that speaks ACP over stdio, e.g. `omp`.
config.backends.env: Extra environment variables for the agent process.
config.backends.installHint: Shown when the command cannot be found.
config.backends.singleSession: Set to `true` if the agent only streams live updates for one session per process (CodeBuddy 2.x). The agent is then restarted before sending in another session. Overrides the built-in value when the entry replaces a built-in agent.
config.backendTrace: Troubleshooting: write every ACP message exchanged with the agent (raw JSON, long ones truncated) to the "Halo: Backend" output channel. Use it to check what the agent actually sent, for example whether a reply had text between tool calls. Turn it off afterwards: messages include file contents.
config.ui.theme: Theme mode of the chat panel.
config.notifications.onlyWhenUnfocused: Only notify when the VS Code window is not in the foreground.
config.notifications.onAttention: Notify when the agent is waiting for your confirmation (approval, question, or plan review).
config.notifications.onTurnComplete: Notify when the agent finishes a turn.
config.notifications.onUnexpectedExit: Notify when the agent or runtime exits unexpectedly.
config.notifications.onScheduledComplete: Notify when a scheduled task or goal completes.
config.schedules.permission: Default unattended permission preset for scheduled tasks. Scheduled tasks open an isolated background session and run to completion with Full Access (`danger-full-access`) by default.
config.schedules.permission.workspace: Workspace Write (allow file edits inside workspace)
config.projects: Per-project worktree settings (files to copy, setup commands, and verification commands).
config.chatCommands: Saved prompt chat commands: type `/` in the input box to pick and insert into the composer, edit before sending; shared across all Agents.
config.chatCommands.name: Command name (without leading `/` and without whitespace), e.g. `review`.
config.chatCommands.description: Short description shown in the `/` completion popup (optional).
config.chatCommands.prompt: Full prompt text filled into the composer when this command is selected.
config.mcpServers: Centrally managed MCP servers handed to your selected Agents on startup. Can also be imported from each Agent's local configuration.
config.protocolGateway: Start the local protocol conversion gateway (off by default). When enabled, converts OpenAI Chat Completions compatible endpoints into the Claude (Anthropic Messages) protocol for Claude Code.
config.acpRegistryUrl: Optional HTTPS URL of an ACP agent registry JSON manifest used to discover external ACP agents in Settings (read-only; never installs automatically).
config.providers: Third-party Coding Plan and custom model provider configurations (such as Volcengine Ark, Zhipu GLM, Alibaba Bailian, MiniMax, Kimi, CLIProxyAPI) and agent bindings. API keys are stored only in OS secret storage and never written to settings.
config.accounts: Official agent account profiles (metadata only; tokens, API keys and cookies are stored in OS secret storage or isolated directories).
config.backendChannels: Per-agent active model channel routing (official account or third-party provider).
